messages:
maria: kicking off a kernel/kv prefetched-bisect sweep across A100 / H100 / L40S. seq lens: 512,1024,2048,4096,8192; batches: 1,2,4,8. comparing flash-v1, flash-paged, fused-paged variants. run id perf-2165-01.

jin: nice — do you have the exact runner config? want to attach perf counters (sm_util, l2_bw, kv_spill_rate).

maria: yep, pasted below. using pinned model xform-7b-quant, kvcache enabled, prefetch=true, kvcache_shard=auto.

maria: ```
# perf-2165-01 config
hardware: A100/H100/L40S
seqs: [512,1024,2048,4096,8192]
batches: [1,2,4,8]
variants: [flash-v1, flash-paged, fused-paged]
metrics: [p95_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, kv_spill_rate, sm_util, l2_bw]
batching: continuous, max_window=64
kv: prefetch=1, eviction_policy=LRU, spill_threshold=0.06
```

thor: quick heads up — last week L40S showed unexpected KV spill at seq=4096 batch=4 with fused-paged. might be the prefetch window getting saturated.

jin: ok noted. I'll watch kv_spill_rate and memory highwater. we should log kernel selection decisions too (which kernel chosen per request).

anita: can we gate fallback earlier? propose rule: if kv_spill_rate > 0.03 AND batch >=4 -> force paged fallback for that model/seq pair.

maria: tried that locally; reduced tail latency but dropped tokens/sec by ~8% on A100. tradeoff depends on SLO.

maria: initial short-run numbers (A100, seq=4096):
```
variant        p95_ms   tokens/s   kv_spill
flash-v1       42.3     1.2k       0.01
fused-paged    65.1     1.6k       0.08  <-- high spill, low p95? (unstable)
flash-paged    48.7     1.1k       0.02
```

jin: weird that fused-paged has higher tokens/s but worse p95 and kv_spill. maybe it's aggressive prefetching causing thrash. can you attach timeline flame?

maria: uploading top flame (attached to CI). highlights: KV eviction spikes coincide with kernel switches and large contiguous allocations.

ci-bot: perf-2165-01: short-run complete for A100. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/perf-2165-01/a100/pack.tar.gz. status: unstable.

anita: can we add a soft-limit to prefetch count per-thread? if prefetch window * batch > threshold -> degrade prefetch aggressiveness.

thor: also log seq-length distribution per batch. We saw certain microbursts where seqs accumulate and hit worst-case mem.

maria: noted. next steps: 1) run extended sweep on H100, L40S, 2) add kernel-choice logging + per-request kv_spill annotated, 3) experiment with anita's soft-limit rule.

jin: I'll wire up a quick analyzer to scan perf artifacts and compute kv_spill_rate per kernel/seq/batch and emit heatmap. should help pick safe thresholds.

maria: thanks — tagging @eng-sre for any infra limits on L40S runs. cc @product for perf-impact visibility.

thor: FYI, if we end up forcing paged fallback a lot, we should quantify the cost delta (tokens/sec vs GPU hours).

maria: agreed. putting a cost/run summary in the next message after H100 run.

jin: re-run queued on H100 and L40S, expect finishes ~2165006940. will post summary heatmaps when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: perf-2165-01: h100 run complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-perf/perf-2165-01/h100/pack.tar.gz. status: review-needed.

maria: received — will parse and follow up with recommended kernel-selection rule (conservative prefetch limit + KV-spill threshold).

anita: if rule OK, we can try a staged rollout: canary on dedicated pool with high-memory margin.

maria: plan: bisect thresholds (0.02,0.03,0.04) + prefetch window (32,48,64). jin: please run analyzer and dump csvs.

jin: on it. I'll post CSV + interactive heatmap link when ready.

maria: thanks team. low-chatter checkin: will publish a short thread in eng-runtime summary after analysis. :white_check_mark:
